faq.q: What is the origin of Alhamdu?
faq.a: Alhamdu is associated with Arabic. Al-ḥamdu ('the praise'), as in al-ḥamdu li-llāh.
Yes — the underlying form الحمد is Arabic.
Alhamdu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Alhamdu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. الحمد لله occurs in the Qur'an (Sūrat al-Fātiḥa 1:2)

faq.a: Romanization variants include Alhamdu, alhamdu. Script forms are الحمد, अलहम्दु.
